daily_report_items: MP Materials full Q2 review completed: Q2 operating progress supports the vertical-integration thesis, but high capital expenditure, prior claims and dilution constrain common-equity value. The accepted USD 18/USD 40/USD 72 scenarios produce USD 42.50 weighted fair value against the USD 56.67 mark, retaining Sell / Avoid and allocation ineligibility. No paper trade or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: MP Materials reported Q2 NdPr production of 840 metric tons, NdPr sales of 1,006 metric tons, USD 108.5 million consolidated revenue and a USD 20.3 million GAAP net loss; segment adjusted EBITDA was USD 32.5 million for Materials and USD 7.5 million for Magnetics.

The current SEC submissions index identifies no later operating filing superseding the August 6 results exhibit and August 7 Form 10-Q.

The immutable schema-v2 assessment links predecessor assessment_9409f60673dc70257720, operation 01M0CZ8BD03F2P6FPWQ5YD26GG, the current page hash and fresh MP/XNYS/USD market and FX identity. Deterministic normalization derives USD 42.50 weighted fair value, USD 32 buy-below price, -25.00% expected return, quality score 68, Sell / Avoid and allocation ineligibility.

The bounded security context contains no payload idea ID and no canonical relationship for this security, so the successful full review requires no idea-research follow-up; the adverse valuation gate also precludes conviction strategy research.
